data.title: MindWalk Reports 21% Revenue Growth and Gross Margin Expansion to 59% in Fiscal First Quarter 2027
data.description: In Austin, Texas, MindWalk Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ: HYFT), specializing in Bio-Native AI technology, disclosed their financial performance for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, concluding on July 31, 2026. This quarter saw the official launch of ReefIQ™, MindWalk's innovative data platform, signaling a transition towards more consistent revenue streams from platforms. The company experienced a notable 21.3% year-over-year revenue surge, reaching $3.8 million. Gross profit also saw a substantial increase, rising by 47.1% to $2.2 million, with the gross margin expanding from 48.3% to 58.6%. Additionally, MindWalk reported a positive net cash flow.

data.title: FedEx Freight Names Michael Rodgers Chief Commercial and Technology Officer
data.description: In Memphis, Tennessee, FedEx Freight has announced Michael Rodgers as their new Chief Commercial and Technology Officer. This appointment signifies a strategic move by the company to drive growth and innovation in key areas. With this new role, Rodgers will oversee the commercial and technological aspects of FedEx Freight's operations, aiming to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.

data.title: Boot Barn Holdings, Inc. Announces September Conference Schedule
data.description: Boot Barn Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BOOT) based in Irvine, California, has disclosed its attendance at upcoming investor conferences. The company will be participating in the Goldman Sachs Global Consumer and Retail Conference on September 15, 2026, with a webcast fireside chat scheduled at 10:45 am Eastern Time. Following this, they will also be present at the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on September 16, 2026, hosting a webcast fireside chat at 11:30 am Eastern Time. John Hazen, the Chief Executive Officer, expressed satisfaction with the performance.

data.title: DFRobot seeMote Cap Opens Preorders at $229, Bringing Real Tools Into Spatial Computing
data.description: DFRobot made an announcement today in Shanghai on September 14, 2026, regarding the release of seeMote Cap. This spatial tracking module is designed for Apple Vision Pro developers and is now open for preorder at $229. The initial batch of orders is scheduled to be shipped by late September. The seeMote Cap serves as a valuable tool for teams looking to prototype visionOS, offering a convenient and efficient solution.

data.title: Dana White’s $1.5-Million Purchase of Ram Charity Trucks, $968,000 Ford GT Sale Highlight Barrett-Jackson’s Return to Las Vegas, with Close to $36 Million Generated in Total Auction Sales
data.description: Scottsdale, Arizona - Dana White recently made headlines with his purchase of Ram charity trucks totaling $1.5 million and the sale of a Ford GT for $968,000, which were key moments during Barrett-Jackson's reentry into Las Vegas.

data.title: Intercont (Cayman) Limited Announces Effective Time of Share Consolidation/Reverse Share Splitto Regain NASDAQ Compliance
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Intercont (Cayman) Limited, a worldwide shipping company, revealed plans to undergo a share consolidation (Reverse Share Split) for its ordinary shares at a ratio of 25-for-1. This change is set to take effect on September 17, 2026, to ensure adherence to Nasdaq’s Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) requiring a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share. This strategic move aims to uphold compliance and financial stability within the company.

data.title: ReDEFY Launches "Built Before the Meeting:" California's Environmental Health Agencies Get a Working Salesforce Solution Ahead of the CERS NextGen Deadline
data.description: One of the highlights at Dreamforce 2026 is the presence of ReDEFY, a leading Salesforce consulting partner. They have developed cutting-edge Environmental Health solutions for California county governments, anticipating the state's CERS NextGen deadline. The company is based in HERNDON, Va., and the event is set to kick off on September 14, 2026. This innovative approach aligns with the growing demand for advanced technologies and regulatory compliance, showcasing the impact of forward-thinking solutions in the industry.

data.title: Toppoint Holdings Inc. Announces Anticipated Reincorporation from Nevada to Delaware
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Toppoint Holdings Inc. revealed its intention to transition from Nevada to Delaware through a planned reincorporation. Toppoint, a prominent truckload services and solutions provider in the recycling export supply chain sector, trades on the NYSE American under the ticker symbol "TOPP". This move is part of a conversion strategy outlined in the Company’s Proxy Statement submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission. The Proxy Statement was initially filed on August 10, 2026, and subsequently supplemented with additional materials on August 24, 2026.

data.title: Hornbeck Offshore Awarded Multi-Year Decommissioning Contract in the North Sea
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. (NYSE: HOS), based in Houston and Covington, Louisiana, disclosed that its subsidiary, Helix Well Ops (U.K.) Limited, has successfully obtained a multi-year decommissioning agreement. This contract marks a significant milestone for the premier integrated offshore services company.

data.title: Oliveda International, Inc. (OLVI) Subsidiary Olive Tree People Inc. Introduces ARISTAEOS – the World’s First Combination of Colostrum and Hydroxytyrosol – from Its Andalusian Olive Trees
data.description: A new product called ARISTAEOS, the first of its kind to combine colostrum and hydroxytyrosol, has been introduced by Olive Tree People Inc., a subsidiary of Oliveda International, Inc. This innovative product aims to bring the benefits of both colostrum and hydroxytyrosol to consumers.

data.title: BURFORD CAPITAL ANNOUNCES PRICING OF PRIVATE OFFERING OF SENIOR SECURED NOTES
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Burford Capital Limited, a prominent global finance and asset management company specializing in law, disclosed the pricing details of its private offering. The company priced $300 million in aggregate principal amount of 8.000% senior secured notes.

data.title: Martial Arts Philosophy Meets the Demands of the Modern Workplace
data.description: "Dr. David Jackson, DBA, MBA, leveraging over 30 years of managerial expertise and close to 50 years of martial arts training, introduces 'The Martial Art of Management,' emphasizing discipline, adaptability, and accountability in team-building. The innovative approach blends principles from both disciplines to foster stronger team dynamics. This initiative was unveiled in Albuquerque, N.M., on September 14, 2026, marking a unique fusion of strategic leadership skills with traditional martial arts values."

data.title: Columbus McKinnon to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences
data.description: On September 14, 2026, in Charlotte, North Carolina, Columbus McKinnon Corporation (Nasdaq: CMCO) disclosed plans to participate in the Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference on September 23, 2026, at around 12:15 p.m. Eastern Time. At the conference, representatives from the company will showcase their insights.

data.title: Starwood Capital Promotes Tim Abram to Head of Asset Management, Europe
data.description: In its continuous efforts to enhance value creation and deal execution in the region, Starwood Capital Group appointed Tim Abram as the new Head of Asset Management on September 14, 2026. This promotion expands the firm's leadership team and underscores its commitment to driving growth and success. Starwood Capital, a prominent private investment firm, aims to further solidify its position in the global market under Abram's guidance.

data.title: Target Names Mark Weinstein Chief Marketing and Guest Experience Officer
data.description: In Minneapolis on September 14, 2026, Target Corporation (NYSE: TGT) revealed the appointment of Mark Weinstein as the new chief marketing and guest experience officer. This move comes into effect immediately. Weinstein will be reporting directly to Michael Fiddelke, who serves as Target's chief executive officer.

data.title: AAOS submits comment letter to CMS on Physician Fee Schedule
data.description: A recent letter from the American Association of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) cautions against proposed payment adjustments that could potentially harm patient access and expedite practice consolidation. The letter, dated September 14, 2026, is addressed to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. The AAOS expresses concerns that these changes may have adverse effects on healthcare services. The warning highlights potential risks to patient care and healthcare providers due to the proposed adjustments in payment structures.

data.title: Valens Semiconductor Appoints Asaf Silberstein to its Board of Directors
data.description: A highly experienced semiconductor industry professional and Chief Operating Officer of Semtech, with over 20 years of expertise in expanding global technology enterprises, has joined Valens Semiconductor in HOD HASHARON, Israel. The appointment was made on September 14, 2026. Valens Semiconductor, listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol VLN, specializes in delivering top-of-the-line connectivity chipsets.

data.title: BabyDoge Acquires LimeWire
data.description: In a recent development, the Web3 ecosystem has successfully acquired the renowned file-sharing brand. Known for its significant achievements, BabyDoge, a part of the Web3 ecosystem, achieved a remarkable market cap exceeding $1 billion. Furthermore, it holds a Guinness World Record for its notable contributions to animal charity initiatives. This acquisition marks a new milestone for BabyDoge as it continues to engage and expand its community.

data.title: Premier Lacrosse League And Whirlpool Brand Team Up For "Lacrosse After Dark" At Pier 17 In NYC
data.description: Starting on September 15, Championship Week for the Premier Lacrosse League (PLL) will commence in New York City at Pier 17. The event will feature a match between the NYPD and FDNY teams, alongside participation from PLL and WLL athletes, all playing against a backdrop of blue lights. Attendees can enjoy free giveaways and also have the opportunity to enter an appliance sweepstakes. The event is set to take place on September 15, 2026, and promises exciting lacrosse action and entertainment for all those in attendance.
